"""Port of the immutable cryptographic ledger."""
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Protocol, Tuple, runtime_checkable


@runtime_checkable
class IAuditLedgerPort(Protocol):
    """Port of the ledger of decisions."""

    async def append(self, entry: Dict[str, Any], *, tenant_id: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
        """Append a record to the chain and return the entry_hash."""
        ...

    async def entries(self, tenant_id: Optional[str] = None) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Return the ordered entries of the tenant."""
        ...

    async def verify(self, tenant_id: Optional[str] = None) -> Tuple[bool, List[str], str, int]:
        """Recompute the Merkle chain from the base."""
        ...
